what: Bound to scroll, text and blocks blur from 0 → 5px while fading out (out — for the hero logo, copy and scroll line, from when the reference element’s top edge touches the top of the screen until its bottom edge does). In: starts at 10px blur and transparent, then sharpens (section top from screen bottom → 20%). In-out: comes in that way, then fades again to 5px blur while the section’s bottom edge goes from screen center → 10%. Buttons that have vanished are also set to visibility hidden, so they can’t be clicked.

options.trigger: Selector of the reference element for measuring (default itself) — for when several elements vanish together based on the same block
options.start / end: ScrollTrigger start·end (out default top top → bottom top, in default top bottom → top 20%)
options.in-start / in-end / out-start / out-end: Two ranges of in-out (default top bottom → top 20% · must be specified)
options.blur: Blur (px) — out uses the end blur, default 5, in and in-out use the start blur, default 10
options.out-blur: Blur when fading out for in-out (px), default 5

use: …
note: The one that only sharpens while drifting in from the upper left is blur-drift-scrub. Used with a video behind the hero, the video alone remains while the text blurs away

from.where: index.html [data-slot=hero] .kv__center·.kv__copy·.kv__line(out, reference .kv__center top 0% → bottom 0%, blur 5) · [data-slot=concept](in-out, top bottom → top 20% blur 10 · bottom center → bottom 10% blur 5) — original script.js key visual scroll animation
